sections.name: Section / Where We Are
sections.title: Close to downtown, without the downtown parking

paras.t: West End Chiropractic is at 1611 W. 5th St., on the ground floor of 5th Street Commons, just off MoPac and near the Whole Foods flagship at 5th and Lamar.

callouts.title: Free covered garage parking
callouts.text: You get downtown access without downtown logistics. The garage is covered and free, so you're not circling the block, feeding a meter, or walking three blocks in the heat.

paras.t: Casey Morgan D.C. built this practice around working people. Your first visit takes about 30 minutes. After that, most visits take a few minutes.

cards.title: Early and midday hours
cards.text: Open at 8am Monday through Thursday, with a midday window most of the downtown lunch crowd can use.

cards.title: Same-day when you need it
cards.text: Same-day appointments are often available. When your back locks up at your desk, you don't have to wait a week.

cards.title: In and out, not rushed
cards.text: One patient put it better than we could: "In and out efficiently, but with care."

sections.name: Section / What We See

paras.t: Long days at a screen, then a hard workout to make up for it. That combination shows up in our office every week.
